version_change_metadata_differences.before: Move the supplied plastic-unit versus android-token distinction into asked facts. Preserve printed-only scope and leave SG01 undecided.

before.finding: The last mapped fact says advance to next standard round without its nonfinal condition, even though this same question expressly asks third-demand omissions and the key says the third ends.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Qualify advancement as nonfinal demand only. Do not require or assert a next standard round after the third demand.

before.finding: The question asks whether eligible owner can normally support the main offer; the map also includes normal counteroffer support in its asked fact.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Require main-offer eligibility only; put normal counteroffer eligibility in context. Leave the three substantive eligibility outcomes intact.

before.finding: The Coach question asks whose victory; Monica asks when and target; Saul asks winning actor, payment recipients and order. The map promotes one/two/one-and-one payout quantities to independent completeness requirements.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Keep all trigger actors, target, optional Monica theft and Saul payout order required. Put the fixed payout quantities and Saul exhaust cost in context. Any volunteered false amount remains material contradiction.

before.finding: The question asks which later unit Media Circus places, not its destination, and asks the alternative effect for 24/7, not the numeric size of the omitted unrest option.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Require strike-to-stable, subsequent one Human First placement, and alternative one orgcrime removal. Keep any-district placement and 24/7 one-stage baseline as context.

before.finding: Each moves twice must be read with the also-required Root return-to-reserve rule. Without locations, two successful on-board moves per unit or two Root entries per unit cannot be guaranteed.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: State two movement instructions per unit subject to removal at Root; give no invented final district or numerical overall threat change. Preserve highest-first and all blocking/Root rules.

before.finding: A correct bar-count method answers how to identify tier; requiring the additional matching border cue would turn a second correct aid into a completeness prerequisite.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Require bar-count identification and no inherent tier effect; mark matching border color as supplementary explanation.

before.finding: Ordinary counteroffer excludes the explicit Fall Guy exception in the map, but the inputs do not define ordinary as necessarily an ordinary hand action. Emergencies are also legal counteroffers elsewhere in these fixed inputs. Universal return-to-hand cannot be extended to them from the supplied facts. Further counteroffers could also be read more broadly than that proposer repeating.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: For a future question version, say ordinary hand-action counteroffer and the returned proposer's further counteroffers. Pending clarification, require supported ordinary-hand case only and do not invent emergency handling, prior-offer revival or global priority. An authoritative category definition or coordinator wording decision is needed to judge a demanded broader interpretation.

before.finding: The final sentence says an action, while its fixed answer means hand action. The surrounding ordinary-action wording supports that intended scope, but an emergency can be stolen by an explicit effect and may already be faceup.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: For a future version, explicitly say ordinary hand action in the final sentence. Preserve the supplied ordinary-hand secrecy result; do not assert universal secrecy of faceup emergencies. No emergency-revelation requirement is added to this candidate.

before.finding: The map has an empty scenario_givens list despite a supplied third-demand failure to threat twenty-five and Federalist capital twenty-five.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Record those as givens; continue requiring scoring order and concrete win/loss result. No outcome changes.

before.finding: The map has an empty scenario_givens list despite starting capital forty-four and a seven-capital loss.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Record both quantities as givens. Still require calculated thirty-seven and actual token side/space before and after.

before.finding: The question asks which decks are separated and complete core setup. The map says only four non-action decks and a random active player, whereas the fixed key identifies the non-action decks and the random capital-token method. Merely citing counts does not identify the requested decks.
before.proposed_versioned_correction: Specify asset, demand, event and investment decks plus the five action types, and retain random capital-token selection of the first active player. These are fixed-key setup facts; no new setup method or changed outcome is introduced.

version_change_metadata_differences.before: Historical seed results do not establish the newly explicit item 9 production requirement; the full new bank will be tested by new readers.
